# Part B — candlestick confirmation / block filters on the existing strategies (research only)

Baseline = stop_variants_3r/prev_oct30 3-year trades (crypto 2023-10-01 → 2026-10-29, forex 2024-01 → 2026-10-30; CHK from 2024-12). Blocks Y1 → 2024-10-31, Y2 → 2025-10-31, Y3 = last 12 months. Net R after fees. DON20 one-position rule applied after filtering.
Filter names: req = keep only if a same-direction pattern; blk = drop if an opposite-direction pattern; sig = on the strategy's own timeframe (entry candle + k earlier), htf = on the next timeframe up (last 1+k completed candles); all = every detector, top = families picked in part A; _0 / _2 = k.
